title: PWR Holdings Full Year 2024 Earnings: Revenues Miss Expectations
text: PWR Holdings shares are down 11% from a week ago . Revenues missed analyst estimates by 2.8% . Revenue is forecast to grow 19% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 8.9% growth forecast for the Global Auto Components industry .

title: Modi wants Tesla to build cars in India. Making the plan work may not be easy
text: Indian PM Narendra Modi and Tesla CEO Elon Musk met earlier this month to discuss plans to set up manufacturing base in India . Tesla is reportedly recruiting and scouting showrooms in the country, following a meeting between Modi and Musk . India introduced an EV policy last year that proposes to lower the import duties on EVs to 15% from 70% . Tesla would also need to follow a 3-year timeline for setting up manufacturing facilities in India, reaching a 50% domestic value addition within 5 years .

title: 42-year-old sold his startup for $1.3 billion—he started by buying a $17,500 camera he couldn't afford
text: Emery Wells, 42, is the CEO of Frame.io, a video collaboration software company he co-founded in 2014 . He sold the company to Adobe for $1.275 billion in 2021 . Wells: "I'd spent almost a decade building this post-production company from scratch"

title: Apple is reportedly preparing an iPhone subscription service that could launch this year
text: Apple is reportedly preparing a hardware subscription service for iPhones . The service would allow customers to buy an iPhone through monthly payments . The move would be similar to how users currently pay for iCloud services . Apple declined to comment, but CEO Tim Cook said in an earnings call that Apple was working on similar products .

title: Chevron beats earnings expectations, returns more than $7 billion to shareholders
text: Chevron beat third-quarter earnings and revenue expectations, returning a record amount of cash to shareholders . The oil major's net income came in at $4.49 billion, down 31% from $3.48 billion in the third quarter of 2023 . The company returned a record $7.7 billion to shareholders in the quarter, including $2.9 billion in dividends . CEO Mike Wirth: "Production was our highest third quarter ever in the history"

title: Apple says antitrust bills could cause 'millions of Americans' to suffer malware attacks
text: The bills are scheduled to be considered in the Senate this week . Apple says the bills could force it to allow apps to be downloaded outside the App Store . Google and Google say the bills would put American innovation at a disadvantage . Amazon, Apple, Google and Meta are among the Chamber of Progress' backers .

title: Genuine Parts to split into industrial and auto businesses; sees weak FY26 profit
text: Title-Genuine Parts to split into industrial and auto businesses; sees weak FY26 profit . The separation into two publicly traded companies – Automotive Parts Group and Industrial Parts Group – follows a settlement late last year with shareholder Elliott Investment Management . The split, which does not require shareholder approval, is expected to be completed in the first quarter of 2027 .

title: Microsoft gets a price target increase from Wells Fargo ahead of earnings
text: Wells Fargo increases Microsoft's price target from $15 to $600 . Analyst Michael Turrin says demand for Microsoft's AI tools and solutions isn't slowing down . The stock has gained more than 30% in the past three months and more than 19% year to date . Most analysts on Wall Street have joined the analyst in taking a bullish stance on Microsoft .

title: Chipotle earnings beat estimates, but stock falls on weak same-store sales forecast
text: Chipotle reported fourth-quarter net income of $331.8 million, or 24 cents per share, up from $282.1 million a year earlier . Same-store sales rose 5.4%, narrowly missing StreetAccount estimates of 5.7% growth . For the past year, Chipotle has outpaced the broader restaurant industry, which has seen traffic slump .

title: Trump flip-flops on Intel CEO, calls him 'success' days after demanding resignation
text: President Donald Trump met with Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan on Monday, days after he called on him to resign . Tan replaced Pat Gelsinger as CEO in March . Tan took over Intel after the chipmaker failed to gain significant traction in the AI market . Tan has been an Intel director since 2022 .

title: Goldman Sachs upgrades this homebuilder stock, says it can outperform despite higher mortgage rates
text: Goldman Sachs upgrades D.R. Horton to buy from neutral in a Monday note . Analyst: Consumer preference for "quick move-in homes" will aid growth for the construction firm . Goldman did trim its target price to $131 from $132, which still equates to 26.3% upside . Mortgage rates have been rising sharply this year as the Federal Reserve tightens monetary policy .

title: Apple now has $162 billion in cash on hand, slightly less than last quarter
text: Apple now has $162.1 billion in cash on hand, slightly less than last quarter . The company reported $89.50 billion in revenue and $1.46 in earnings per share for its fiscal fourth quarter . Analysts expected Apple to post its fourth-consecutive quarter of revenue decline .

title: Everything we know about Tesla's robotaxi launch in Austin
text: The service will be limited to a geofenced area of the city and remote drivers will be monitoring . The first driverless trip from the factory to a customer house is expected on his birthday, June 28 . Tesla's FSD capabilities have been connected to accidents and fatalities, according to data tracked by the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration .

title: INTC: Intel stock Jumps 6% on report of Apple investment talks in early stage
text: Intel Corp. has approached Apple Inc. about a potential investment as part of efforts to revive its semiconductor business . The chipmaker's shares surged about 6% on upon the report, reflecting investor optimism . Apple ceased using Intel-designed processors several years ago, opting instead for its in-house ARM-based chips, a transition completed in 2023 .

title: Bank of America expects a jobs report dud on Friday
text: The bank anticipates a 60,000 increase in nonfarm payrolls in July, below the 100,000 Dow Jones consensus estimate . "If that forecast is correct, the knee-jerk market response will probably be dovish," an economist says . While government employment jumped in June, that appears to be a seasonal distortion .

title: Alphabet dumps more than 90% of its stake in Robinhood
text: Alphabet dumps more than 90% of its stake in Robinhood, 23andMe and Duolingo . The company sold more than 4.3 million shares of Robinhood during the period ending June 30 . Robinhood posted its first profit as a publicly traded company on Aug. 2 .

title: NASA still expects Boeing's Starliner to return astronauts from ISS, but notes SpaceX backup option
text: NASA officials say Boeing's Starliner capsule "Calypso" may return as soon as the end of this month from its extended stay at the International Space Station . The spacecraft has now been in space 36 days and counting as the agency and Boeing perform additional testing in New Mexico before clearing the spacecraft to return . The agency's other transportation option would be SpaceX's Crew Dragon, which would be the backup option .

title: IBM Misses on Q4 Earnings Despite Solid Hybrid Cloud Demand
text: IBM reported modest fourth-quarter 2022 results, wherein the bottom line missed the Zacks Consensus Estimate but the top line beat the same . The company witnessed healthy demand for hybrid cloud and AI solutions with a client-focused portfolio and broad-based growth . The top line surpassed the consensus estimate of $15,548 million .

title: AvalonBay Communities, Inc. (NYSE:AVB) Q3 2023 Earnings Call Transcript
text: AvalonBay Communities, Inc. (NYSE:AVB) Q3 2023 Earnings Conference Call . Today's conference call will be the company's third quarter 2023 earnings conference call . At this time all participants are in a listen-only mode . Following remarks by the company, we will conduct a question-and-answer session .

title: Dover Second Quarter 2024 Earnings: Beats Expectations
text: The company's share price is broadly unchanged from a week ago . Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 1.4% and earnings per share beat expectations by 8.2% . Revenue is forecast to grow 3.1% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 3.5% growth forecast for the Machinery industry in the US .

title: Pfizer to discontinue twice-daily weight loss pill due to high rates of adverse side effects
text: Pfizer to discontinue twice-daily weight loss pill due to high rates of adverse side effects . Pfizer says it still plans to release data on a once-a-day version of the drug in the first half of 2024 . Wall Street was looking for the pill to show 14% to 15% weight loss to be competitive .

title: Pfizer's Covid drug Paxlovid may reduce the risk of developing long Covid, study says
text: People who take Pfizer's Covid antiviral treatment Paxlovid shortly after infection may reduce their risk of developing long Covid, new research suggests . The study only enrolled people who are eligible for the drug under emergency use authorization . The FDA is expected to make a decision in May about whether to approve the drug .

title: Apple earnings are coming out postmarket Thursday. Here’s what top analysts expect
text: Apple is set to release fiscal third-quarter earnings after the stock market close Thursday . Analysts estimate that Apple will earn $1.33 per share on revenue of $89.54 billion . Apple beat Wall Street's forecasts for earnings and revenue in the fiscal second quarter .

title: GM, Ford furlough another 500 workers due to UAW strike
text: GM, Ford furlough another 500 workers due to UAW strike in its 18th day . GM and Ford say they are indefinitely laying off more than 500 workers at four Midwestern plants . Chrysler parent Stellantis has furloughed nearly 370 workers in Ohio and Indiana . The UAW on Friday expanded the first-ever simultaneous strike against the Detroit Three to a GM Lansing, Michigan plant .

title: El S&P 500 y el Nasdaq registran su mejor semana desde noviembre
text: The Dow Jones subió 112.64 puntos, o un 0.33%, a 34,302.61 . The Nasdaq, de gran peso tecnológico, tuvo el mejora desempeño of the semana . Precios subieron a un ritmo del 6.5% en comparación del año anterior .

title: Wolfe Research says buy First Solar, a 'uniquely positioned' clean energy stock poised to rally nearly 30%
text: Wolfe Research says First Solar is well-positioned to fend off growing clean energy competition . Analyst Steve Fleishman upgraded the solar stock to an outperform rating in a note to clients Friday . He said First Solar's weak third-quarter results and guidance cut also create an optimal entry point for investors . The stock has surged more than 50% this year and 7% this month .

title: Oracle stock dips 5% as Blue Owl Capital pulls out of funding $10 billion data center
text: Oracle stock dips 5% as Blue Owl Capital pulls out of funding $10 billion data center in Michigan . The Financial Times reported the plans fell through due to concerns about Oracle's rising debt levels and extensive artificial intelligence spending . Other AI names also sank on Wednesday, with Broadcom down 4%, Nvidia down 3%, AMD down 5% and CoreWeave falling 7%.

title: Moderna's 2Q earnings beat expectations, but it writes off $500 million in expiring Covid shots
text: Title-Moderna's 2Q earnings beat expectations, but it writes off $500 million in expiring Covid shots . The Boston biotech company generated $4.7 billion in sales for the quarter, a 9% increase over the same period last year . Moderna maintained its 2022 Covid vaccine sales guidance of $21 billion .

title: Boeing factory strike crosses 1-month mark as pressure mounts on new CEO
text: Boeing last week pulled a sweetened contract offer that the union rejected . Boeing has filed an unfair labor practice charge with the National Labor Relations Board . S&P Global Ratings last week warned Boeing that it was at risk of a downgrade to junk status . Boeing's 737 Max and 767s and 777s production costs the company more than $1 billion per month .

title: Dollar General shareholders pass proposal to improve worker safety
text: Shareholders pass proposal to create independent audit into worker safety . Dollar General has racked up more than $21 million in fines from the federal OSHA for safety hazards . Since 2014, 49 people have been killed and 172 injured at Dollar General stores by gun violence . The company is the fastest-growing retailer in the country by store count .

title: Businesses added 208,000 jobs in September, better than expected, ADP reports
text: Businesses added 208,000 jobs in September, better than the 200,000 Dow Jones estimate and ahead of the upwardly revised 185,000 in August . Goods-producing industries reported a loss of 29,000 positions, with manufacturing down 13,000 and natural resources and mining losing 16,000 . A big jump in trade, transportation and utilities helped offset those losses .

title: Vietnam Air, Boeing near $7.5 billion deal for 50 737 max planes
text: Vietnam Airlines is expected to sign an initial agreement to buy about 50 Boeing 737 Max jets in a deal valued at about $7.5 billion . The deal would be worth up to $7 billion at list prices, and usually companies that buy in bulk get discounts . U.S. President Joe Biden visits Hanoi to boost ties with former foe .

title: Wells Fargo did enough to remain in our portfolio. What we liked about earnings
text: Wells Fargo did enough to remain in our portfolio . The knee-jerk selling of Wells Fargo shares after a largely strong second-quarter earnings report made no sense . Total revenue at the bank increased 8.6% year over year to $22.62 billion in the second quarter, outpacing the LSEG-compiled consensus estimate of $21.84 billion .

title: Broadcom beats earnings estimates, announces 10-for-1 stock split
text: Broadcom posted earnings for the second fiscal quarter that ended in May beat analysts' estimates . The chipmaker also announced a 10-for-1 stock split, set to begin trading on a split-adjusted basis on July 15 . Broadcom said $3.1 billion in sales during the quarter could be attributed to revenue from AI products .

title: There are signs of change in the M&A market. Bank of America gives their buyout candidates
text: Health care and tech are on pace for their best dealmaking years since 1997 and 2016 . Bank of America reported 150 deals so far this year, 9% lower than last year . Tech, led by software, is up because of ample cash from strategic acquirers and sub-sector fragmentation .

title: Pro traders are watching Pfizer after a big move last week and two other stocks with earnings on deck
text: Title-Pro traders are watching Pfizer after a big move last week and two other stocks with earnings on deck . Pfizer is up more than 1.5% for the year after its 15.2% rally last week . Delta Air Lines and PepsiCo could present a buying opportunity in un-loved parts of the market .

title: Brazil's Jair Bolsonaro applies for 6-month U.S. visitor visa
text: Former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro has filed a request for a six-month visitor visa to stay in the U.S. The move indicates he may have no immediate intention of returning home, where legal issues await . He left Brazil for Florida on Dec. 30, two days before inauguration of his leftist rival, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva .

title: FICO® Score 10 T Decisively Outperforms VantageScore 4.0 in Mortgage Predictive Accuracy
text: FICO: FICO Score 10 T Decisively Outperforms VantageScore 4.0 in mortgage origination predictive power . FICO data scientists established that FICO® Score . 10 T far exceeds Classic FICO in detecting loan losses . V.antageScore attempts to improve the predictive performance of V.0 by including mortgage-specific variables .

title: Apple wants more sports rights, change how broadcasts are done, Eddy Cue says
text: Apple is looking to create a "level of differentiation" from other sports broadcasters . The company has not yet secured rights to major American sports . It is looking at ways to improve the quality of broadcasts on Apple TV . It wants to work with other sports networks to make it easier to stream live .

title: Apple's 4-day slide puts Microsoft back on top as most valuable company
text: Apple's 4-day slide puts Microsoft back on top as most valuable company . Apple is getting hit the hardest among tech's megacap companies due to the iPhone maker's reliance on China . President Trump's decision to impose tariffs on imports from more than 100 countries has sparked fears of a recession brought on by rising prices .

title: JPMorgan traders are getting worried and have turned cautious on the market. Here's why
text: Title-JPMorgan traders are getting nervous about the state of the current stock market . Traders at the bank say they've turned "tactically cautious" on stocks until volatility in the bond market and selling in tech stocks subside . The bank's traders remain confident in the underlying fundamentals of the market .

title: Berkshire Hathaway's annual meeting — Buffett's 'Woodstock for Capitalists' — set to return in person after 2 years virtual
text: Berkshire Hathaway's annual meeting — Buffett's 'Woodstock for Capitalists' — set to return in person after 2 years virtual with Covid-19 restrictions . The event offers a rare chance for investors to hear from legendary investor Warren Buffett, who usually participates in a marathon Q&A session for a few hours .

title: CVS beats Q1 expectations, cuts outlook after buying spree
text: CVS Health says it now expects adjusted earnings of $8.50-to-$8.70 per share for the year . The company completed a roughly $10.6 billion acquisition of primary care provider Oak Street Health in February . It also closed in March an approximately $8 billion deal to buy home health care provider Signify Health .

title: Kraft Heinz Is A Buy With Insider Purchase And High Dividend Yield (Technical Analysis)
text: Kraft Heinz is a buy, supported by bullish technicals, undervaluation, and a recent $5M CEO insider purchase . I would exit or reduce KHC if it trades below its 30-week EMA or if long-term momentum turns negative . KHC offers a 6.4% dividend yield, well-covered by $3.8B in free cash flow versus $1.895B in dividends paid .

title: Elon Musk ordered Nvidia to ship thousands of AI chips reserved for Tesla to X and xAI
text: Elon Musk ordered Nvidia to ship thousands of AI chips reserved for Tesla to X and xAI . The decision is extreme given the scarcity of Nvidia's technology . Musk has promised to build a $500 million "Dojo" supercomputer in Buffalo, New York and a "super dense, water-cooled supercomputer cluster" at the company's factory in Austin, Texas .

title: Mark Wiedman, a top BlackRock exec thought to be Fink's successor, is leaving the company
text: BlackRock is the world's largest bank with $11.5 billion worth of assets . The company has been in touch with the public for more than 20 years . It is believed to be looking to expand its business in the United States . The firm is looking to use the public money to fund more of its global operations .

title: Tapestry shares more than doubled in 6 months, and one investor thinks gains could be limited from here
text: Title-Tapestry shares have been on a stellar run, up 120% in just six months . Sylvia Jablonski, Defiance ETFs co-founder and CEO, explains why she would take her gains now . Shares of Tapestry jumped 13% Thursday, hitting an all-time high . Roblox shares sank 11% after fourth-quarter results missed expectations .

title: CVS beats on earnings, remains mum on 2025 revenue guidance
text: CVS reported fourth quarter and full-year 2024 earnings beat Wall Street's expectations . The healthcare benefits segment was down slightly, with ongoing Medicare and Medicaid headwinds . CVS announced its guidance for 2025 earnings per share of between $5.75 and $6, but it didn't provide annual revenue guidance .

title: Why Jim Cramer wants to load up on more shares of this DuPont spinoff
text: Qnity Electronics, now spun off from DuPont, moved higher in its public debut on the New York Stock Exchange on Monday . Jim Cramer touted the company as a great play on growth in semiconductors due to the artificial intelligence boom . The company already derives roughly 15% of its sales from AI data centers .

title: Disney to pay Comcast $438.7 million to take full control of Hulu, ending lengthy valuation process
text: Disney has agreed to pay Comcast $438.7 million for its stake in Hulu . Disney took two-thirds ownership of Hulu when it acquired Fox's entertainment assets . The two companies had agreed on a guaranteed minimum value of $27.5 billion in 2019 . Disney will record the payment in its "net income attributable to noncontrolling interests" in its fiscal third quarter .

title: Should Elon Musk be paid $56 billion? Tesla shareholders get to vote
text: Tesla shareholders vote on whether to reinstate Elon Musk's $56 billion pay package for CEO . A Delaware state judge struck down the deal in January . Shareholders are voting online ahead of the automaker's June 13 annual meeting in Austin, Texas . The vote is a test of investors' faith in Musk, who has become an increasingly polarizing figure .

title: Expect a return to more 'normal' investing where stock picking is rewarded, Goldman Sachs says
text: Goldman Sachs: Growth will be significantly less concentrated in a post-pandemic world marked by higher inflation and interest rates . The current bull cycle hasn't been an ideal environment for stock pickers as most stocks swung back in unison in the rebound from Covid-induced slump .

title: Netflix secures U.S. rights to the FIFA Women's World Cup in 2027, 2031
text: Netflix has secured exclusive rights in the U.S. to the FIFA Women's World Cup in 2027 and 2031 . The 2027 tournament is set to take place in 12 cities across Brazil . The host country for the 2031 tournament is yet to be announced . Netflix will stream its first ever National Football League games on Christmas Day .

title: Elliott has built a stake in Global Payments. How the activist can help the company lift its share price
text: Elliott Investment Management has built a stake in Global Payments . The company trades around $80 per share and at a high single-digit multiple . Elliott has historically focused on strategic activism in the technology sector . This is about a company that made a poorly received "bet the farm" acquisition and is at an inflection point .

title: Brazil touts climate credentials as Amazon deforestation falls — but draws criticism over oil bet
text: President Luiz Inácio Lula has promised to stop deforestation in the Amazon by 2030 . Rate of deforestation in Brazil's rainforest has fallen to its lowest level in six years . Lula's government has received criticism over its plans to open new oil fields near the Amazon River .

title: Wells Fargo downgrades Qualcomm, says exposure to smartphone industry will hurt chip stock
text: Wells Fargo downgrades Qualcomm, says exposure to smartphone industry will hurt chip stock . Analyst says number of smartphones is likely to decline in 2023 and then grow modestly afterward . Smartphones are considered a big-ticket purchase that consumers may skip or think more thoughtfully about as inflation pinches pocketbooks .

title: These are Morgan Stanley's highest conviction plays for earnings season
text: Morgan Stanley sees upside for several stocks as their latest fiscal results are announced . The firm sees near-term catalysts driving "a meaningful move" upward . Morgan Stanley is forecasting beats on all key performance indicators, including Americas organic growth and margins . Microsoft is expected to announce its fiscal first-quarter results on Oct. 30 .

title: CNBC Daily Open: Tech investors buy the dip — but debt remains a concern
text: After a bruising week for the tech trade, investors seem to have came back into the sector . Investors are once again piling into tech, after fears over AI financing, rising competition and possible excess chip supply in a few years drove them to cash out of the market last week . The optimism is cautious, with debt concerns still a key worry for a sector that has seen record bond issuance this year .

title: Duke Energy (DUK) to Build 150 MW of Solar Sites in Florida
text: Duke Energy Corp.'s DUK arm, Duke Energy Florida, recently announced the commencement of the construction of two new solar sites in Florida by the end of March 2023 . The construction of the solar sites is expected to reach completion in nine to 12 months and will collectively generate energy that will be enough to power 23,000 homes . Duke Energy aims to reach its target of net-zero carbon emissions from electric generation by 2050 .

title: FCC moves to expel one of Hong Kong’s largest telco companies from U.S. networks
text: Title-FCC moves to expel one of Hong Kong’s largest telco companies from U.S. networks . Government agency asked HKT, which is a subsidiary of information and communication technology giant PCCW, to justify why its authorizations should not be revoked . Hong Kong-listed shares of HKT fell more than 5% in Thursday trading .

title: Amazon just announced a new $60 tablet
text: Amazon announced a new Fire 7 tablet for $59.99 on Wednesday . The new model has a 40% longer battery life than its predecessor . It also has a 30% faster processor that should help the tablet feel more responsive . Amazon also introduced a new version of Fire 7 Kids, which ships with a "kid-proof" case with a year of Amazon Kids+.

title: Musk embraces Trump and scorns subsidies. But Tesla still lobbies for US benefits
text: Tesla founder and chief executive Elon Musk endorsed Donald Trump for president last month . But Tesla continues to lobby the U.S. and state governments for benefits championed by the Democratic Party . Musk's willingness to overlook outright Republican opposition to an industry he helped pioneer signals a broader focus on goals that may not dovetail with his businesses .

title: PG&E Full Year 2024 Earnings: EPS Misses Expectations
text: PG&E shares are up 1.6% from a week ago . Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 4.3% . Revenue is forecast to grow 3.2% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 5.1% growth forecast for the Electric Utilities industry in the US .

title: TJX Companies Inc (TJX) Q3 2026 Earnings Call Highlights: Strong Sales Growth and Improved ...
text: TJX Companies Inc (NYSE:TJX) reported a 5% increase in comp sales, surpassing their plan, driven by strong growth across all divisions . The company raised its full-year guidance for sales and profitability due to above-plan results . TJX Canada's segment profit margin decreased by 20 basis points due to unfavorable transactional foreign exchange .

title: Experts seriously doubt whether patent waivers on Covid-19 vaccines will ever come to be
text: Experts doubt whether patent waivers on Covid-19 vaccines will ever come to be . Bill Gates was among those who originally spoke out against the patent waiver . Gates later reversed his stance and is now in full support of temporarily waiving the protections over coronavirus vaccine patents . Critics say waivers will not automatically lead to an improvement in global vaccine distribution .

title: United Airlines will halt service at New York's JFK airport
text: United has been flying just twice daily to San Francisco and Los Angeles from New York's JFK airport . The airline had threatened to take action if the Federal Aviation Administration did not grant the air carrier additional flights . United said the decision would impact 100 employees who work at JFK but "no one is losing their job"

title: GM continues to evaluate Twitter advertising suspension following Musk takeover
text: Twitter has suspended advertising on the social media platform . The move is part of a plan to protect advertisers . The company is looking at how it will work with other advertisers in the future . The suspension of advertising on social media has been put on hold for a period of about a month .

title: CrowdStrike is defying Wall Street negativity on software, says Cramer. What he expects from earnings
text: CrowdStrike is "one company that seems to be immune" to the negativity, Cramer says . CrowdStrike has yet to miss a quarter since it came public, he says . The cybersecurity firm is expected to report results on Tuesday . Workday and Intuit have reported soft-than-expected results in the enterprise software market .

title: Boeing 737 Max crash families say planemaker should face much higher fine
text: Families for some of the 346 people killed in two fatal Boeing 737 Max crashes say planemaker should face much higher fine . Planemaker finalized agreement to plead guilty to criminal fraud conspiracy charge and pay up to $487 million . Lawyer for some families says fine "is inadequate -- or, at the very least, rests on misleading accounting"

title: Charles Schwab Third Quarter 2024 Earnings: Beats Expectations
text: Charles Schwab (NYSE:SCHW) Third Quarter 2024 Results: Beat Expectations . Company's shares are up 4.2% from a week ago . Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 1.3% and earnings per share beat 3.0% . Revenue is forecast to grow 10% p.a. on average during the next 3 years .

text: Lloyd Blankfein warns Iran war fallout 'is going to last' even if 'there's a resolution tomorrow' The Goldman Sachs senior chairman urged investors to prioritize contingency planning amid the turmoil . He said certain parts of the market may be too complacent in their approach to the conflict .

title: Elon Musk wants more control of Tesla, seeks 25% voting power
text: Elon Musk says he wants about 25% of voting power over Tesla . Musk already owns 13% of Tesla, or approximately 411 million shares . Musk sold tens of billions of dollars worth of his shares in Tesla in 2022, largely to finance a $44 billion buyout of Twitter .

text: Bank of America upgraded shares of Puerto Rico-based Popular Inc. on Tuesday, lifting its rating to buy from hold . Analyst Brandon Berman raised his price target to $156 from $141, implying upside of 14% . Shares have surged to start 2026, up 13% thus far, and they've gained more than 40% in the past 12 months .

title: Nike CEO John Donahoe says brands need to stand by their values amid DeSantis, Disney feud
text: Nike CEO John Donahoe says brands need to stand by their values amid DeSantis, Disney feud . Nike CEO: "If it's core to who you are and your values, then no, you stand up for your values" Disney CEO Bob Iger slammed Florida Republicans' controversial bill limiting classroom discussion of sexual orientation in February 2022 .

text: Delta and United accounted for more than 86% of the profits posted by the seven largest airlines last year . United recently unveiled a revamped Polaris class, its top-tier cabin for longer-haul flights, as well as dedicated lounges .

text: WeRide rallied as much as 6% in early trading Tuesday to $19.43 . title: Buy these high-quality small-cap stocks with solid growth and attractive valuations, Goldman Sachs says
text: Small-cap stocks have taken a hit so far this year, Goldman Sachs says . The Russell 2000 is now down 3.9% since the start of the new year . The S & P 500, by comparison, has climbed 1.6% year to date . The group had roared back in the fourth quarter and closed 2023 with more than 15% gain .

title: Amazon announces new $99 Kindle e-reader with better screen
text: Amazon announces new $99 Kindle e-reader with better screen and more storage . The new model has a new USB-C charger and is more water-resistant than the Paperwhite . Amazon also introduced a new Kindle Kids model with similar upgrades . Both devices are available for preorder beginning Tuesday .

title: Archer Daniels (ADM) Delays Earning Release, Revises Outlook
text: Title-Archer Daniels (ADM) Delays Earning Release, Revises Outlook for the year ending Dec 31, 2023 . The company also delays the filing of its annual report on Form 10-K . title: Private payrolls increased by 103,000 in November, below expectations, ADP says
text: Private payrolls increased by 103,000 in November, below expectations, ADP says . Annual pay increased 5.6%, which ADP said was the smallest gain since September 2021 .
